title: Retrying a radio link
intro: A sensor sends its reading over a radio link and retries until an attempt gets through. Each attempt gets through with probability p = 0.8, independently. X, the number of the attempt that first gets through, is geometric. The value of interest is k = 3: P(X = 3) = 0.032 and P(X ≤ 3) = 0.992. The mean is 1/p = 1.25 attempts.
